Commerce and Industries (FBCCI) has welcomed the decision for price re-

adjustment of fuel oil as it would decrease the pressure on the national

economy despite the global crisis.

reduction of diesel, petrol, octane and kerosene just after a day of cut in

import duty and withdrawal of advance tax.
